name: channel_classify_user
content: Classify this {channel} thread ({lane} mailbox). Respond with ONLY the JSON object.

variables.name: channel
variables.description: Channel word ('email' | 'chat' | 'message'), from channel_providers::channel_label — kept generic.

variables.name: lane
variables.description: Whose mailbox this is, in words ('the owner's' | 'the agent's (Presto's)').

variables.name: subject
variables.description: Thread subject (metadata; redacted rows never reach the classifier).

variables.name: recipient_domains
variables.description: Distinct recipient DOMAINS only (never full addresses), comma-joined.

variables.name: label_ids
variables.description: Provider label ids on the thread (e.g. inbox, sent), comma-joined.

variables.name: message_count
variables.description: Number of messages in the thread.

variables.name: age
variables.description: How long since the last message ('today' | 'N days ago' | 'unknown').

variables.name: latest_message_id
variables.description: Message id for the newest distilled message this classification is based on.

variables.name: latest_message_age
variables.description: How long since the newest distilled message.

variables.name: latest_direction
variables.description: Latest distilled message direction relative to the account owner ('inbound' | 'outbound' | 'unknown').

variables.name: latest_intent
variables.description: The local distiller's intent for the latest distilled message.

variables.name: needs_reply_hint
variables.description: The local distiller's boolean reply hint.

variables.name: follow_up_hint
variables.description: The local distiller's compact follow-up hint JSON, or 'none'.

variables.name: recent_handled_followups
variables.description: Bounded JSON array of recent acknowledged/dismissed follow-ups in this same provider/account/thread, or 'none'. Used only to decide repeat_of_recently_handled.

variables.name: summary
variables.description: The locally-derived thread summary — the ONLY content the classifier sees; never a raw body.
examples: Sender asked for a response about the pending item.

metadata.description: User prompt for channel-assist thread classification (channel_classify): metadata + LOCALLY-DERIVED summary/signals of ONE thread -> {label, confidence, reason, follow_up_kind, action_owner, due_text, urgency, repeat_of_recently_handled, proposed_action}. Body-blind by design — the classifier sees only local derived signals and metadata, never a raw body — so it may run on a local OR remote profile bound to operation `channel_classify`.
metadata.author: magician
metadata.changelog: v1.0.0: Initial channel-assist thread classification user prompt.
